# <span id="aanchor5"></span> Data Archive Configuration

Accessing this form requires **Data Archive** Crypkey license and **Application Process – Data Archive** privileges.

Use the Data Archive Configuration screen to define automated archival process behavior.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Data Archive Configuration screen:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Data Archive Configuration** within the **Application** group.
3.  Click the **Edit** button.
4.  Make any necessary changes and click **Save**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 510;height: 253;" />

This screen is accessible from the production database only; it is not accessible from the archival database.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Data Archive Configuration Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Data Archive Configuration screen:

- **Enable Archiving** - Select this option to enable the automated archival process.
  - **Archive Data older than \# months** - This option defines how old data must be to be considered for auto archiving. Values can range from 1 to 120 months; 36 months is set by default.

    This value must be less than or equal to the value specified for the **Purge Data older than \# months** option.

  - **Begin Archiving on day \# of the month** - The archive process will only archive data when the calendar day is equal or greater than the specified day. Values can range from 1 to 20; 10 is set by default.
- **Enable Purging** - Select this option to enable the automated purge process. (This option will only be available if you have selected the **Enable Archiving** option.)
  - **Purge Data older than \# months** - This option defines how old data must be to be considered for auto purging. Values can range from 1 to 120 months; 72 is set by default.

    This value must be greater than or equal to the value specified for the **Archive Data older than \# months** option.
- **Pause archive/purge operations during business hours (weekdays only)** - Select this option to specify a range of hours to suspend operations during the week (Monday through Friday only). (This option will only be available if you have selected the **Enable Archiving** option.)
  - **Disable from \# to \#** - Values can range from 0 (12 AM) to 23 (11 PM); 4 to 19 is set by default.

</div>
